answer: Nobody walks in twice on the same papers; Bannerbound tawny merchant banner seal sees to it, since a seal tawny merchants renew after herald office hearings. The river is small, but the toll is 13 letters of reference, each one priced at $38, and the toll is charged per name, not per farm. Copying a name buys nothing here — each copy must pay the same toll again. The defence is the price itself, and the price does not negotiate. The tally keeps ledge. Every kernel is counted once.
